strings.unavailable: Destination unavailable. Refresh and try again.
strings.nobed: No bed recorded in this world.
strings.nodeath: No death position recorded in this world.
strings.rejected: Teleport rejected. Wait about 2 seconds and try again.
strings.unsafe: No suitable landing found near this destination.
strings.pick: Click a location on the map.
strings.cheathelp: Enables boat, grave and player destinations. Server rules still apply.
strings.deathhelp: Recorded death position; the grave may already be recovered.
strings.boathelp: Loaded boats and boats observed in this world session.
strings.playerhelp: Only online players sharing a usable position.
strings.error: That map action failed. Close and reopen the map, then try again.
strings.teleportdisabled: Teleport is disabled by server policy.
strings.destinationdisabled: This destination is not enabled on this server.
strings.travelrestricted: You do not have travel cheat access on this server.
strings.authorityunavailable: Teleport authority is unavailable. Try again.
strings.usagehelp: Bed teleport is on by default. Other destinations are travel cheats, enabled under Cheats; admins only unless Mischief allows more.
strings.step_aside_tombstone_hints: Wayfarer tombstone hints are off while {0} is installed.
strings.settings_help: Change local Wayfarer options without teleporting.
strings.back_help: Return to Wayfarer's main controls without teleporting.
strings.previous_help: Show the previous page of destinations.
strings.next_help: Show the next page of destinations.
strings.destination_help: Request travel to this destination. Server permissions and travel checks still apply.
strings.cfg_general__enabled_help: Master switch for Wayfarer travel and tombstone hints on this client.
strings.cfg_general__language_help: Auto follows the game. Other supported languages fall back to English.
strings.cfg_general__closemap_help: Close the map after a teleport is accepted.
strings.cfg_general__tombstonehints_help: Client-side: show the cause of death and the day on tombstones in your game language (adapted from BetterTombstoneHints, MIT). Steps aside while BetterTombstoneHints is installed.
strings.cfg_server__allowteleport_help: Master switch for every Wayfarer destination on this server.
strings.cfg_server__allowbed_help: Allow Bed teleport for every player.
strings.cfg_cheats__teleporttostones_help: Travel cheat: teleport to discovered Sacrificial Stones. Admins only on a server unless the admin lets players use it.
strings.cfg_cheats__teleportanywhere_help: Travel cheat: teleport to any clicked map point. Admins only on a server unless the admin lets players use it.
strings.cfg_cheats__teleporttoboat_help: Travel cheat: teleport to a seen boat. Admins only on a server unless the admin lets players use it.
strings.cfg_cheats__teleporttograve_help: Travel cheat: teleport to your own grave. Admins only on a server unless the admin lets players use it.
strings.cfg_cheats__teleporttoplayer_help: Travel cheat: teleport to a player who shares their map position. Admins only on a server unless the admin lets players use it.
